Pre-Qualification Criteria: 1) Average Annual turnover for last three (3) years should be minimum 01 Lakh. The firm must attach Bala nce Sheet and profit & loss statement of last 3 years duly audited by Chartered Accountant for evaluation of the financial capacity/ turnover. However, for turnover of less than Rs.01 crore, self certified Balance Sh eet, Profit & Loss statement will also be acceptable {As per YIL SPM 2024 para 3.10 (c) (iii) [Pg. No. 49]}. 2) The firm must have experience of supplying same or similar items [Experience of manufacturing / suppl ying of Ceramic Components] in Central/State Govt. Organization/PSU Dept./Public Listed Company or any reputed organization during last 3 years. The firm must attach scanned copy of experience certificate like Supply Order copy/CRAC copy/Tax Invoice copy/Job Completion Certificate copy etc. (for last 3 years) for evaluation of its offer along with technical bid {As per YIL SPM 2024 para 3.10 (c) (i) [Pg. No. 49]}. The experience criteria of GeM GTC will be superseded by this clause. Other Terms & Conditions: (i) Payment Terms: 100% within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of material at MSF. Spot payment/ A dvance payment will not be admissible. (ii) LD Clause: Delivery must be completed within 60 days after placement of Supply Order. If the Seller fa ils to deliver the material within stipulated Delivery Period, MSF shall be entitled to recover from the Seller liquidated damages, by way of penalty a sum of 0.5% per week of delay or part thereof, subject to a maxi mum of 10% as our claim towards liquidated damages on the undelivered part of the order. Imposition, rec overy or settlement of this LD shall not affect Buyer’s right to performance, compensation and termination of the agreement. (iii) Firm shall furnish Test Certificate (T.C) of OEM and GC/WC for 12 months / 01 year for any man ufacturing related defects along with store. In case of defective Stores which need to be re-supplied To & F ro freight, insurance charges if any required for replacement have to be paid by the seller. Warranty calls needs to be attended within 07 days. The guarantee/warranty period would be extended by equivalent per iod for which the material is not available for the repaired parts, which were repaired & replaced during the Warranty period. (iv) Bidders shall offer their quotes only on firm and fixed basis. Evaluation of the bid shall be made on the basis of the seller’s offer price as per the basic rate of the item including delivery charge(s) [i.e. transporta tion, loading-unloading, and local levies, landed prices at consignee destination i.e. F.O.R MSF etc.] at con signee destination. Seller must quote their offer price as per the basic rate of the item including delivery c harge(s) [i.e. transportation, loading-unloading, and local levies, landed prices at consignee destination i.e . F.O.R MSF etc.] at consignee destination and all taxes like GST/IGST etc. separately. (v) Participating firms must submit a declaration duly filled , signed & stamped (as per attached format), t hat they comply with all terms and conditions of GeM Bid. (vi) As per MSE policy “If the bidder wants to avail the purchase preference, the bidder must be a manufac turer of the offered products for supply of goods”. In this regards bidder has to submit the declaration agai nst manufacturer of the offered products / goods in firm’s letter head duly signed & stamped and also sub mit the Factory License and Plant & Machinery details to verify the same. (Disclaimer: If any false declarati on found in this regards, the legal action deemed fit will be taken as per the Govt. Rule). (vii) The clauses of these Buyer Added Terms & Conditions i.e. ATC will supersede the clauses of GeM GTC and other relevant clauses and T&Cs in the bid documents. (viii) If the Supply Order value exceed 10 Lakhs, Performance Security Deposit (PSD) will be applicable @ 5 % valid for 14 months from the date of final acceptance. This clause will supersede other PSD related claus es in the bid documents. (ix) Participating firms must go through the attached DRG NO: CCS-723/R1 {for sl. nos. 01, 02, 04, 05, 0 6} and DRG NO: CCS-849 {for sl. no. 03} & comply with the same (with sign & stamp).
